senses.gloss: m. pl. (ξύλα, = σκέυη ξύλινα, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Ships, a var. lect. quoted below) the wooden implements of a ship, oars, ladders, poles &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:1">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 1</cite> he who sells a ship <he>מכר את האיסכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>איסק׳</he>) sells implicitly the oars &c., (Mish.
B. Bath. V, 1 מנהיגין); B. Bath. 73ᵃ (Rashi אִסְכְּלִין, Ms. M. אסכליא, Ms. R. אסקלה, Ms. O. איסכלניא, read אִיסְכְּלִינָא). [Comm. ladders = scalæ.—As to transpos. of כס, cmp. דוכסוסטוס.]
